nodes.label: publish-tauri
nodes.rationale: Matrix CI job that builds and publishes SSHyar releases on tag push (v*) for Windows and Linux via tauri-apps/tauri-action.

nodes.label: ubuntu-24.04
nodes.rationale: Linux release runner; AppImage/deb built on Ubuntu 24.04 to match WebKitGTK 4.1 desktop requirement.

nodes.label: Windows DPAPI
nodes.rationale: Default vault key wrapping on Windows when no master password is set; stored as vault.key.dpapi.

nodes.label: Master password lock
nodes.rationale: Optional vault lock; when unset, platform-native key storage (DPAPI or vault.key.raw) is used instead.

nodes.label: Profiles
nodes.rationale: Host, user, password or key, group, tags, search, post-connect command, keepalive, and remote shell selection (bash/zsh/fish/sh/custom/server default).

nodes.label: SFTP
nodes.rationale: Graphical SFTP with browse, multi-select, upload/download progress, mkdir/rename/delete, copy/cut/paste, View/Edit with syntax highlighting, and Follow shell cwd sync.

nodes.label: Snippets
nodes.rationale: Vault-backed commands injected into the active terminal.

nodes.label: SSHyar
nodes.rationale: Desktop SSH helper for Windows and Linux with embedded terminal, encrypted profile vault, graphical SFTP, snippets, and optional master-password lock.

nodes.label: Terminal
nodes.rationale: Local shell plus OpenSSH in a real PTY (PowerShell/ConPTY on Windows; $SHELL on Linux) with session tabs and reconnect.

nodes.label: Vault
nodes.rationale: AES-GCM encrypted vault; Windows uses DPAPI by default; Linux uses a user-only key file (0600); optional master password for set/change/remove/lock.

nodes.label: vault.key.dpapi
nodes.rationale: DPAPI-wrapped vault key on Windows when no master password is used.

nodes.label: vault.key.raw
nodes.rationale: Local vault key file with mode 0600 on Linux when no master password is used; Linux counterpart to Windows DPAPI wrapping.

hyperedges.label: Vault encrypted data and platform key files
